review_scope: All 135 stored records classified and given explicit field states. Twelve records received a detailed stored-evidence audit and a public retrieval attempt. Only separately approved key-terms receipts refresh factual review dates.

publication_policy.homepage_window_applies_to: Every promoted work example, including approved network fallbacks.
publication_policy.expiry_mechanism: Evaluate approved review age at build and in the small homepage runtime guard; keep absolute dates and a neutral Browse fallback.
publication_policy.approval_required: Material source changes remain candidates until a source-content review records evidence and an explicit reviewer.

fact_state_definitions.sourced: A value is supported by cited stored research or an explicitly receipted source-content review; dates and scope remain visible.
fact_state_definitions.source_not_stated: The specific reviewed source did not state this field; this is not a claim that no provider source publishes it.
fact_state_definitions.not_researched: The field has not been reviewed; no successful review date is asserted.
fact_state_definitions.conflicting: Recorded source statements or field components need reconciliation; no personal eligibility or universal rate is inferred.

retrieval_state_note: Blocked, missing, unavailable and script-shell responses are retrieval outcomes. They preserve last sourced facts and never establish closure or current intake.
